EQT Ventures Invests $10 Million in Enterprise AI Company Edra

Edra runs a platform that helps automate work by connecting to a company’s existing systems

By

STOCKHOLM—EQT Ventures, the venture capital arm of Swedish buyout group EQT, has invested $10 million in enterprise artificial-intelligence company Edra.

The investment comes after EQT Group deployed Edra’s technology to aid its internal IT service desk in a four-week pilot. The company said it has continued to use Edra within its IT operations to support the handling of employee requests and plans to roll it out to other areas of its business.
